name: Faro
mandate: PrompTugal.news Faro: AI and technology in Faro, a university city whose centre of gravity is the Universidade do Algarve, its research and its startup campus, and what reaches Faro from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent; every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Faro is home to the Universidade do Algarve, whose campuses in the city anchor most of the region's AI activity: research (a 31.5 million euro archaeological innovation centre that will use AI), teaching (a published university AI policy, a health-AI executive course with a health-tech company), and the UALG TEC Campus where business events on AI are held. The community layer is also here: GDG Faro runs the city's developer conference on agentic AI, and Algarve Evolution, Algarve STP and the council add events and programmes. The municipality itself shows little AI use in what we could read, so innovation and research, not city government, is Faro's centre of gravity.

sources.title: UAlg secures 31.5 million euros for an archaeological innovation centre using AI (Barlavento, 23 April 2026)
UAlg defines rules and principles for the use of AI (Universidade do Algarve, 24 September 2026)
AuroraMed launches an AI in health course with UAlg (Barlavento, 19 March 2026)
DevFest dedicates two days to practical AI in Faro (Barlavento, 6 November 2026)

look.landmark: Arco da Vila, the neoclassical gate into Faro's old town
look.motif: Ria Formosa lagoon blues, white storks on the bell towers, a university town by the water

ai_news.title: Equipa UAlg returns to schools with 81 free talks, AI and cybersecurity among them
ai_news.summary: The University of Algarve's 2026/2027 school outreach catalogue offers 81 free talks and activities in 16 areas, including AI applied to health, teaching and mathematics, and cybersecurity, delivered by UAlg teachers and researchers at schools, campuses or online.
ai_news.ai_path: A university programme that puts AI talks in front of Algarve pupils and teachers: AI is one topic in the catalogue, one step from the story.

ai_news.title: DevFest in Faro spends two days on agentic AI
ai_news.summary: GDG Faro's free conference runs on 27 and 28 November at the University of Algarve's Campus da Penha, with workshops and talks on building, securing and scaling AI applications.
ai_news.ai_path: A developer conference on building AI applications, held in Faro: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Vibathon Algarve 2026 fills UALG TEC Campus with people building apps with AI
ai_news.summary: A sold-out day on 31 October 2026 in Faro run by Algarve Evolution with the Lovable AI tool: free credits, mentors and a jury, and many participants with no coding experience built working prototypes.
ai_news.ai_path: A hands-on AI app-building day held in Faro: directly about AI. The article's author, Dinis Cruz, spoke at the event and is PrompTugal's operator, so read it as an insider's account.

ai_news.title: Faro's Cáritas asks who benefits from AI
ai_news.summary: The diocesan Cáritas held a conference at the Seminário de São José in Faro on AI, human dignity, work, learning and who may be left behind.
ai_news.ai_path: A public conference in Faro on the social effects of AI: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: University of Algarve joins the global alliance for responsible AI in higher education
ai_news.summary: UAlg has joined GeSI's Digital Education for Impact Alliance (DEFIA), launched in Portugal on 15 October 2026 at the University of Coimbra, and was represented by its vice-rector Eduardo Esteves. The conference presented a national declaration on responsible AI in higher education.
ai_news.ai_path: A Faro university joins a network on the responsible use of AI in teaching and research: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: A book on starting a company in 30 days with AI prompts is presented at UALG TEC Campus
ai_news.summary: More than 50 people came to UALG TEC Campus in Faro on 30 September 2026, with Algarve STP and local firms, for a founders' book published by Edit'AI that gives a 30-day method with ready-to-use AI prompts.
ai_news.ai_path: A Faro launch of a startup method built on AI prompts: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Open science meets AI at the University of Algarve's ConfOA 2026
ai_news.summary: The Lusophone Open Science Conference was hosted at the Gambelas campus from 6 to 9 October 2026, with this year's theme on how AI changes research, scientific communication and data policy.
ai_news.ai_path: A national research conference on science in the age of AI, hosted by Faro's university: directly about AI. The date is the conference start because the page shows no publication date.

ai_news.title: University of Algarve publishes its AI policy
ai_news.summary: The university set out principles, duties and good practice for using AI across students, teachers, researchers and staff, with a humanist approach and a push for secure institutional tools.
ai_news.ai_path: The Faro-based university sets its own rules for AI use: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Regional health unit holds a webinar on AI in the health service
ai_news.summary: ULS Algarve invited discussion of the chances, risks and conditions for AI in Portugal's health service, stressing that AI should support and not replace clinical judgement.
ai_news.ai_path: The Algarve health unit debates AI in healthcare: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: GDG Faro holds a Build with Gemma AI hackathon
ai_news.summary: GDG Faro's community page lists a free hackathon, Build with Gemma: GDG Faro AI Hackathon, on 18 July 2026, ahead of its DevFest on 27 and 28 November. The page gives no venue, speakers or results.
ai_news.ai_path: A developer community hackathon built around an AI model: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Faro panel asks how AI search decides which businesses to show
ai_news.summary: Flow Productions with Algarve STP and the Ireland Portugal Business Network held a hybrid panel at UALG TEC Campus on AI-driven search and company visibility.
ai_news.ai_path: A business panel in Faro on how AI systems recommend companies: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Algarve STP picks 12 firms for its first Venture Lab, AI among the sectors
ai_news.summary: The programme offers mentoring on customers, markets, pricing and scale to startups across biotech, AI, health, tourism, food and creative industries. Two named firms, expressTEC in Faro and Bot Gonçalves, use AI.
ai_news.ai_path: A regional startup programme whose cohort includes AI companies, one of them based in Faro: one step from AI.

ai_news.title: New Lusiadas hospital in Faro is billed as native to AI
ai_news.summary: Grupo Lusiadas Saude presented a 60 million euro hospital in Faro (Lejana de Baixo), due to open at the end of 2027 with about 500 jobs. Its chief executive said it will be a hospital native to artificial intelligence, robotics and advanced diagnostics. The article gives no detail on which AI systems.
ai_news.ai_path: A private hospital planned in Faro whose chief executive says AI will be built in: AI is the stated design principle, but no system is named, so one step.

ai_news.title: SNS patients can do physiotherapy at home with AI correcting their movements, ULS Algarve among the units
ai_news.summary: From 22 June 2026 doctors in the national health service can prescribe home physiotherapy on a tablet-like device from the Portuguese company Sword Health, where AI analyses movements and corrects them in real time with a clinical team reviewing. ULS Algarve is one of nine local health units that signed AI protocols. The article does not mention Faro and does not say ULS Algarve runs the service.
ai_news.ai_path: AI-guided rehabilitation offered to patients of the regional health unit based in Faro: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Venture Lab opens a free mentoring call whose topics include technology and AI
ai_news.summary: Algarve STP's programme for 12 Algarve startups and SMEs, under Algarve Empreende 2026, listed technology and artificial intelligence among its mentoring topics, with UAlg, AMAL, NERA, ANJE and Algarve Evolution as partners. Applications closed on 24 June 2026.
ai_news.ai_path: A startup mentoring programme that covers AI adoption, run from the Faro ecosystem around the university: one step from AI.

ai_news.title: Digitalisation secretary tells the Algarve to pick robotics and AI as its hub focus
ai_news.summary: At a Vilamoura lunch debate opened by the UAlg rector's office, the speaker argued the region should choose a few priorities, and an Algarve company's chief warned the region has under 10 percent of the computing capacity AI needs.
ai_news.ai_path: A regional AI strategy debate in which the University of Algarve is a named partner: directly about AI, one step from Faro.

ai_news.title: University of Algarve wins 31.5 million euros for an AI-using archaeology centre
ai_news.summary: ICArEHB secured funding including 15 million euros from Horizon Europe's Teaming for Excellence for UAlgTec Heritage, a centre that will use AI to forecast risks to sites and support public authorities.
ai_news.ai_path: A Faro university research centre that will apply AI to heritage protection: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: WordPress Faro Meetup asks how AI changes the way people use websites
ai_news.summary: The local WordPress Faro Meetup met on 16 April 2026 at UALG TEC Campus. Jorge Cabaco of Dengun Agency spoke on AI copilots on websites, lead generation, customer support, booking systems and tourism AI concierges.
ai_news.ai_path: A community meetup in Faro on AI inside websites: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: Turismo do Algarve schedules AI and water bootcamps with hospitality schools, Faro included
ai_news.summary: Two free certified bootcamps for tourism workers: water efficiency on 9 April in Faro and AI applied to tourism on 17 April in Portimão.
ai_news.ai_path: Regional training in AI for tourism, with the Faro hospitality school a partner: one step from AI.

ai_news.title: European funds to bring AI and robotics to 15 Algarve tourism firms
ai_news.summary: Algarve 2030 will fund digital maturity checks and action plans, run by Algarve Evolution, for 15 tourism SMEs adopting AI and robotics.
ai_news.ai_path: A region-wide AI adoption programme run by an association that works with Faro's university and incubator: one step from AI.

ai_news.title: AuroraMed and UAlg launch an AI course for health leaders
ai_news.summary: The executive course ran on 20 April 2026 at the University of Algarve in Faro, with PRR-funded scholarships for selected participants.
ai_news.ai_path: A university course on AI for healthcare managers: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: UAlg's new rector says AI should be used in teaching, not banned
ai_news.summary: In an interview with ECO, rector Alexandra Teodosio (in office since 17 December 2025) opposed banning AI and said buying detection software is not worth it because AI keeps changing; she wants it introduced in a way that stimulates critical thinking and a shift towards continuous assessment.
ai_news.ai_path: The head of the Faro-based university sets out her stance on AI in teaching: directly about AI.

ai_news.title: AI4Youth Work brings an Erasmus+ project on AI for youth workers to UALG TEC Campus
ai_news.summary: Contextos and Algarve STP ran an English-language co-creation session in Faro on 2 April 2025 about helping youth workers use AI tools, with ethics and digital inclusion on the agenda.
ai_news.ai_path: A session on AI for youth work held in Faro: directly about AI. Older than the 2026 items.

sources.name: Diario da Republica, public contracts (Municipio de Faro notices)

events.title: Mentes artificiais, olá Futuro (Faro municipal library, council)
events.ai_path: A month-long library event whose title points to AI, and the page gives no programme, so directly about AI as far as the title shows.

events.title: Novembro Digital, an exhibition on artificial intelligence (Alliance Française de l'Algarve, IPDJ Faro)
events.ai_path: An exhibition about AI listed on the council's agenda: directly about AI.

events.title: Do you know UAlgTec Heritage? (Algarve Evolution, Faro)
events.ai_path: UAlgTec Heritage is the 31.5 million euro UAlg centre that will use AI on archaeological heritage: one step from AI. The listing gives no programme.

events.title: Open Mic Pitch Night, second edition (Algarve Evolution, Faro)
DevFest 2026: Build, Secure and Scale in the Agentic Era (GDG Faro, Campus da Penha)
events.ai_path: A two-day conference on agentic AI: directly about AI.

events.title: Algarve 2030 and Público conference on AI and water management, update with details
events.note: 14:00 to 18:00, Auditório 1.4, Campus da Penha, University of the Algarve, Faro; panels on smart water management and smart cities with water and municipal utility bodies (Águas do Algarve, AMAL, APA among them); minister closes online; no registration stated; no change to date

ai_map.name: Universidade do Algarve (UAlg)
ai_map.what: The Algarve's public university, with its main contact address in Faro. Published an AI use policy on 24 September 2026.
ai_map.ai_path: Sets AI policy and hosts AI research and courses.

ai_map.name: ICArEHB (UAlg research centre)
ai_map.what: UAlg archaeology research centre behind UAlgTec Heritage, funded with 31.5 million euros to use AI in heritage protection.
ai_map.ai_path: Will apply AI to risk forecasting and decision support for archaeological sites.

ai_map.name: UALG TEC Campus
ai_map.what: The University of Algarve's technology incubator and accelerator on its Penha campus in Faro, opened in March 2022 with about 16 companies and 300 workers, mostly in information technology. It has since hosted the July 2026 AI search panel, the 30 September 2026 founders' book launch and Vibathon Algarve 2026 on 31 October.
ai_map.ai_path: Hosts startups and AI events.

ai_map.name: expressTEC
ai_map.what: Faro biotech startup spun out of UAlg research, building an RNA-based test to guide cancer therapy, with machine-learning software that produces the clinical report.
ai_map.ai_path: A machine-learning product at the core of its test (the source is sponsored content).

ai_map.name: GDG Faro
ai_map.what: Independent, community-run developer meetup in Faro. Runs DevFest 2026 and ran an AI hackathon on Gemma on 18 July 2026.
ai_map.ai_path: Its events are about building with AI.

ai_map.name: Algarve Evolution
ai_map.what: Association of entrepreneurs, talent and startups (106 active members by its own count) building an innovation ecosystem in the Algarve. Ran Vibathon Algarve 2026 in Faro on 31 October, runs the AI and Robotics programme for 15 tourism SMEs, and hosts events in Faro including one on UAlgTec Heritage on 17 November. Its pages do not state a base city.
ai_map.ai_path: Runs an AI and robotics adoption programme and the regional digital ecosystem.

ai_map.name: Algarve STP
ai_map.what: Science and technology park association that ran the first Venture Lab (12 firms, AI among the sectors) and co-hosted the July 2026 AI panel at UALG TEC Campus.
ai_map.ai_path: Mentors AI startups and hosts AI events.

ai_map.name: AuroraMed
ai_map.what: Portuguese health-tech company applying AI to clinical management, which launched an AI course with UAlg's medical faculty in Faro.
ai_map.ai_path: Sells AI for healthcare and trains its leaders.

ai_map.name: Flow Productions
ai_map.what: Organised the July 2026 hybrid panel at UALG TEC Campus on AI search and company visibility, with Algarve STP.
ai_map.ai_path: Convenes business audiences on AI search.

ai_map.name: ULS Algarve
ai_map.what: The Algarve's local health unit, which held a webinar on AI in the national health service on 15 September 2026.
ai_map.ai_path: A public health body debating AI in care.

ai_map.name: Câmara Municipal de Faro
ai_map.what: The council lists a month-long AI-themed library event and an AI exhibition in November 2026. It also updates its urban-planning submission platform, with no AI use stated.
ai_map.ai_path: Hosts public AI events, with no AI use in its own services found.

ai_map.name: Cáritas Diocesana do Algarve
ai_map.what: Held an AI and human dignity conference at Faro's Seminário de São José on 29 October 2026.
ai_map.ai_path: Civil society debating AI's social effects.

ai_map.name: Dengun
ai_map.what: An Algarve-based company whose chief executive said in May 2026 that it plans to create 150 technology companies in the region within seven years and that the region lacks AI computing capacity. Its base city is not stated on the page we read.
ai_map.ai_path: Argues for regional AI infrastructure.

ai_map.name: CEOT (Centro de Eletrónica, Optoelectrónica e Telecomunicações, UAlg)
ai_map.what: UAlg research centre that co-organised a 2024 workshop on deep learning for NIR chemometrics, AI applied to food control.
ai_map.ai_path: Applies deep learning to spectroscopy data.

ai_map.name: Edit'AI
ai_map.what: Publisher of the founders' book with AI prompts that was presented at UALG TEC Campus in Faro on 30 September 2026.
ai_map.ai_path: Publishes an AI-based startup method.

ai_map.name: Geek Girls Faro
ai_map.what: Faro chapter of Geek Girls Portugal, which held an event in 2019 on women in AI and tech. We found nothing newer.
ai_map.ai_path: A tech community that has put women in AI on its programme.

ai_map.name: CRIA (UAlg entrepreneurship and technology transfer division)
ai_map.what: Runs UAlg's proof-of-concept validation programme for technology projects at maturity levels 3 to 6 (June 2026 call) and the Ideias em Caixa business-idea competition, with Algarve Evolution, Algarve STP, ANJE, AMAL and NERA.
ai_map.ai_path: Matures university technology, AI projects included, into startups.

ai_map.name: CCDR Algarve
ai_map.what: The Algarve's regional development body. Started its first AI course for its own staff in October 2025, 21 hours with ISCTE and funded by Algarve 2030. The page does not state its base city.
ai_map.ai_path: A regional public body training its staff in AI.

ai_map.name: MTI (Managing The Intelligence)
ai_map.what: UAlg spin-off founded in October 2019 and based at UALG TEC Campus. Sensors and a web app switch off hotel room air conditioning when a window opens or a room is empty. Backed by Portugal Ventures.
ai_map.ai_path: Its origin was a research project using AI algorithms, but the 2022 article does not say how the product uses AI now.

ai_map.name: NOVA LINCS, UAlg pole (engineering laboratory, Campus da Penha)
ai_map.what: A UAlg research centre in Faro. A November 2025 call for a one-year research grant starting in January 2026 places the work there, on the AI.INSIGHTS project (AI-powered real-time anonymous user monitoring), funded by Algarve FEDER, seeking computer vision and AI skills.
ai_map.ai_path: Runs an AI research project in Faro.

ai_map.name: SPIC
ai_map.what: A digital studio based in the Algarve (the page does not name the town) with an R&D consortium with UAlg. In 2023 it used AI trained on more than 9,000 records to build a stage hologram for the band D'ZRT.
ai_map.ai_path: Builds AI-made holograms and co-develops projects with UAlg.

ai_map.name: AI4Youth Work (Erasmus+ project, with Contextos and Algarve STP)
ai_map.what: An Erasmus+ project to help youth workers use AI tools, with partners in Portugal, Greece, Italy and Romania. Its Algarve session was held at UALG TEC Campus in Faro on 2 April 2025.
ai_map.ai_path: A European project on AI for youth work, presented in Faro.

ai_map.name: Grupo Lusiadas Saude (Hospital Lusiadas Faro, under construction)
ai_map.what: Private health group building its fourth Algarve hospital in Faro (60 million euros, opening end of 2027), which its chief executive calls native to AI and robotics.
ai_map.ai_path: Plans AI built into a new Faro hospital; no system named yet.

ai_map.name: Sword Health
ai_map.what: Portuguese company whose AI-guided home physiotherapy device is now prescribable in the national health service, ULS Algarve among the local health units that signed AI protocols. Its base city is not given on the page, so it is not placed in Faro.
ai_map.ai_path: Supplies the AI that corrects patients' exercises: directly about AI.

ai_map.name: GeSI DEFIA (Digital Education for Impact Alliance), with UAlg as a new member
ai_map.what: Global network promoting responsible AI in higher education; DEFIA Portugal was launched on 15 October 2026 and UAlg recently joined.
ai_map.ai_path: A network on responsible AI in teaching and research: directly about AI.

ai_map.name: Equipa UAlg (school outreach programme)
ai_map.what: UAlg programme with 81 free school talks in 2026/2027, AI and cybersecurity among them.
ai_map.ai_path: Brings AI topics to schools: one step.

gaps: Faro's council shows no AI use in its own services in what we could read (its news page, agenda and Balcão Digital mention none). We should look for council minutes, procurement notices on base.gov.pt and the Balcão Digital's technical pages.

We could not open postal.pt, algarvestp.pt or bot-goncalves.pt (a bot challenge or a host this session cannot reach), so Algarve STP, Bot Gonçalves and Postal do Algarve are only reached through Barlavento. Bot Gonçalves is not placed in Faro because no page we opened says where it is.
No feed found for the council, UAlg or Algarve Evolution. Barlavento's RSS works, while Sul Informação's feed returned 403.
Dengun's base city is not stated on the page we read, so it is not placed in Faro. Sul Informação, which covers it, and dengun.com both answer 403 to us.

Missing: dates for Algarve Evolution's AIA community meetups beyond what its own events page lists, since the listings also sit on meetup.com and luma.com, which we do not read, and weather from IPMA.
Algarve Evolution's own events page tags no event as AI. We list events by their content and say so.
AMAL, the Região de Turismo do Algarve and the Faro airport belong on the map as public bodies, but the pages we read do not connect them to AI, so we left them out for now.

Investors: the entries above are grants, a programme and one 2022 venture investment. We found no 2025 or 2026 funding round for a Faro company. Sources to look for: Portugal Ventures and Banco de Fomento notices, and company announcements (expressTEC and AuroraMed first).
Local talent is not filled: no Faro source lists anyone, and nobody has agreed to be listed here.

Still unsourced: other UAlg research groups beyond CEOT and NOVA LINCS, the Faro hospital's AI use, and Invisible CFO, FarmAssist and Witflow, whose base cities no page we opened gives. SPIC's town is also not stated.
Barlavento's AI tag shows no new Faro AI story dated after 6 November 2026 at 04:00 UTC on 16 November.

Faro council does run an economic development desk (Faro Invest) and a business nest managed by ANJE, but its incubation page names no services, price, sector or way to apply, and neither page mentions AI. We still need ANJE's own page for the nest.

The council's one candidate for AI in a public service is the inclusive virtual assistant of the Acessibilidades 2.0 project, run by Associação Salvador with the council (a 2025 focus group, a June 2026 launch session at the municipal library, a demonstration in October 2026). None of the three pages we read says it uses AI, so it is not on the AI map. If the project or the council confirms it, it becomes the council's first AI service.

Faro council tenders: the 2026 Diario da Republica notices we could read (8 May, 3.46 million euros, Bairro Ribeirinho urban renewal; 15 June, 113,450 euros, pavements) are not about AI or software. A PRR-funded urban management platform rental appears in a TED notice (35382-2026) that returned no readable text, so it is unconfirmed.

Sul Informacao (403 on search and article pages) and Algarve Primeiro's search (readable, but no AI story in its 16 November list) gave nothing new on Faro AI; postal.pt article pages opened but its AI search hits were mostly 2024 to 2025 or already in the file.
algarveevolution.pt event pages (UAlgTec Heritage, Open Mic Pitch Night, Feira de Estagios, CardioTech) all returned 503, so only the listing page was read: no descriptions and no AI tag.
No new AI story about Faro dated after 6 November 2026 on Barlavento's AI tag or Faro section; nothing AI on UAlg's news page between 29 Oct and 16 Nov except the school-talks catalogue.

Faro airport: ANA's biometric page returned no text, and the AHETA article (2 March 2026) describes EES border checks with biometrics but no AI or facial recognition, so airport AI is not claimed. Search results say Vision-Box biometrics cover Faro but we did not open a page that says so.

Acessibilidades 2.0 (Municipio de Faro and Associacao Salvador): the council's 3 November 2026 news says students tried a virtual assistant and a mapping app, but does not say either uses AI, so not listed as AI news.

4Global Portugal (sports data and AI, said to be in Ualg Tec Start) came only from a search snippet of racius.com; not opened, not added. Witflow, Deloitte Faro office and Invisible CFO: no AI page opened.

No 2026 Algarve Tech Hub Summit page for Faro found (past editions in Lagos 2025 and elsewhere). CCDR Algarve news page 404; no Algarve 2030 AI call for companies confirmed as open (a 4 million euro digitalisation call named in a search result was not opened).
ULS Algarve (Faro hospital): no AI project of its own found in 2026; robotic surgery (since November 2025) is robotics, not AI, and its pages were not opened.
UAlg agenda for November lists no AI event; its Faro neighbours' AI items (Olhao Bairros Digitais, Loule, Sao Bras) belong to their own town files: the Bairros Digitais article does not mention AI.

Barlavento tag page and feed returned only a JPEG (unreadable). cm-faro.pt latest news has nothing on AI (a 3 Nov accessibility app item does not call itself AI). ualg.pt news first page has no new AI item beyond the already-listed schools talks. DevFest Faro 27-28 Nov: no update found.
cm-faro.pt news 16 Nov (type 1 diabetes training) and 3 Nov (Map4Accessibility with a 'virtual assistant', no AI stated) do not pass the test.
No GDG Faro DevFest 2026 listing page found (gdg.community.dev); only Algarve Evolution and the existing Barlavento item.

voice.lede: Faro, oh pá: where the storks nest on the bell tower, the lagoon sulks at low tide, and the university quietly teaches the whole Algarve to talk to machines, while somebody launches yet another startup book at the TEC Campus.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Faro, a tua cidade das cegonhas: AI and tech in Faro, with the Universidade do Algarve as the big brain on the hill, plus whatever news sails in from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independente, and every fact comes with a receipt.
voice.gravity: Faro is the only place where an old-town arch and a 31.5 million euro AI archaeology centre can share a postcard. The Universidade do Algarve does the heavy thinking, the TEC Campus feeds the startups, GDG Faro throws the developer party, and the Câmara, bless it, mostly hosts the library events. Innovation and research, sim senhor, not city hall.
voice.gaps_intro: Ainda não sabemos tudo, pá. Here is what Faro has not told us yet:

start_company.name: Faro council: Desenvolvimento económico (Faro Invest)
start_company.what: The council's economic development desk lists technological and business innovation as a priority and names spin-offs from the University of Algarve, strategic and individual investors and service entrepreneurs as its audiences. Meetings are by appointment.

start_company.name: Faro council: business incubation (a business nest managed by ANJE)
start_company.what: Spaces for microenterprises and emerging projects of young entrepreneurs. The page names no services, price, sector or application channel, and points to IEFP and CRIA at the University of Algarve.

start_company.name: UALG TEC Campus
start_company.what: Technology incubator and accelerator on UAlg's Penha campus in Faro, opened in 2022, mostly information technology.

start_company.name: Ideias em Caixa (UAlg and CRIA)
start_company.what: Business-idea competition: 40 ideas get maturation sessions and the top idea in each of eight categories wins 5,000 euros. Open to over 18s and firms under three years old (8th edition, 2024 to 2025).

start_company.name: UAlg proof-of-concept programme (CRIA)
start_company.what: Takes technology projects from maturity level 3 to 6 towards demonstration in a real setting. The June 2026 call closed on 10 July.

start_company.name: Venture Lab by Algarve STP
start_company.what: Free mentoring for 12 validated Algarve startups and SMEs, funded by Algarve 2030. The 2026 call closed on 24 June.

start_company.name: Algarve Evolution
start_company.what: Lists an incubator, the Founder2Founder growth programme and INOVA Algarve 3.0 for tourism firms adopting AI and robotics.

start_company.name: International Sci-Tech Innovation Competition (information session at UALG TEC Campus, 21 July 2026)
start_company.what: A China and Portuguese- and Spanish-speaking countries contest with prizes up to about 25 million euros across 100 projects, run by two chambers of commerce with Algarve Evolution. Winners can reach over 50 investment funds in the Greater Bay Area. No deadline stated.

investors.name: Horizon Europe, Teaming for Excellence (European Commission) into UAlgTec Heritage
investors.what: 15 million euros of the 31.5 million euro package for the University of Algarve's archaeology centre ICArEHB.
investors.ai_path: Funds a centre that will use AI on archaeological heritage: directly about AI.

investors.name: Portugal Ventures into MTI (Managing The Intelligence)
